cv.name: Marcus Rivera-Sloan
cv.headline: Logistics Coordinator | Last-Mile & Distribution | Former restaurant manager
cv.summary: Logistics coordinator who moved into supply chain in 2023 after five years managing restaurants. Running a busy kitchen taught me scheduling, vendor management and staying calm when the truck is late; I now apply that to last-mile delivery.

experience.title: Logistics Coordinator
bullets: Plan daily routes for 25 drivers serving grocery and pharmacy clients
Raised on-time delivery from 91% to 96% by rebalancing routes in Onfleet
Track carrier invoices and resolve billing disputes
Train new dispatchers on the TMS

experience.title: Logistics Associate
bullets: Scheduled inbound deliveries and kept inventory records in NetSuite

experience.title: General Manager
bullets: Managed a 60-seat restaurant with 22 staff and US$2.1M annual sales
Negotiated with food distributors and cut food cost by 4 points

experience.title: Assistant Manager
bullets: Handled staff scheduling and vendor orders
